Dr. Alex Example

ASSESSMENT

STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES
1. Describe and apply the concepts of recursion, object-oriented design, abstract data types,
and algorithm analysis.
2. Implement and compare classic data structures.

COURSE GRADES

The course grade will be based on the four quizzes, five assignments, two exams, and class

participation and attendance. The following is a tentative point assignment for the course (the

points of homework are only estimates and subject to adjustment):

Category Points

Assignments 500 (100  4, 50  2)

Midterm Exam 100

Final Exam 200
4

Quizzes 200 (50  4)

Total 1,000

The final grade is calculated by adding the number of points that the student earned divided by the

total number of possible points. The following table gives the final conversion scale for course

grades:

Scale Grade

90 – 100 % A

80 – 89 % B

70 – 79 % C

60 – 69 % D

59% and below F

LATE WORK POLICY

Late work can gain partial credit under the following policy:

Up to 1 day 10%

Up to 2 days 20%

EXAMS
There will be a midterm exam and a final exam covering the textbook, lectures, and other
materials discussed in class. No makeup exam will be offered. The exams will be
worth 300 points and will be 30 percent of your course grade.

QUIZZES
Four quizzes will be given to help ensure students stay up with assigned material. The Quiz will
be multiple choice or essay questions. The quizzes will be worth 200 points and will be 20 percent of your course
grade.

ACADEMIC INTEGRITY
Copying another student's program, in whole or in part, results in a
50% deduction.
